fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-02-28, farm fencing of the complainant was damaged near Roja Park Main Street, with a repair estimate of about Rs. 55,000. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-02-28 at roughly 21:25. Contact details given by the complainant, Suresh Pandian, include the number 9000000074. The complaint refers to Dinesh Balan, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000363. The complaint mentions Madhan Babu, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000490, in connection with the events. A witness, Pandian Balan, reachable on 9000000285, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage, photographs and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property allegedly damaged following a local dispute.
fields.Keywords: property damage, vandalism, night, mobile number, CCTV, main street, associate, photograph
